top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Advance, Brent Crude Holds Losses: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures edged higher while oil held its losses as traders awaited details of US-China talks ahead of a summit between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
